title: card
description: The fields every card shares (ADR-017 §5). A type's schema refers to this one, adds its own fields, never gives one of these another meaning, and refuses any field neither names (unevaluatedProperties). Values the instance decides (people, topics, tags) are references into urn:famstack:vault, which the validator builds from the memory repo. `kind` (ADR-017 §5) is named by the types that have variants, diary and list, so a type without them refuses it.

type.description: The card type (ADR-017 §6). Its schema says which other fields the card has.

card_id.description: <type>-<value>, made once when the card is first written, never changed (ADR-016).

title.description: What the card is called. Headings and renderers take it from here.

description.description: One sentence on what the card is.

date.description: The day the card is about, YYYY-MM-DD.

persons.description: Ids of the people the card is about (ADR-017 §4).

former_card_ids.description: Ids the card had before, so old links still find it (ADR-016).

timestamp.description: an ISO time in UTC, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ, with or without milliseconds

aliases.description: The other names the thing goes by.
